entries.claim: The Angelic Salutation on pp. 9–10 reads “blessed art thou amongst women”. The English prayer here has “among women”. The Angelus on pp. 26–27 directs the reader to repeat the Hail Mary.
entries.reader_note: The 1901 edition reads “amongst women” at this point.

Historical English source expression: “Let us pray.” This supplies the corresponding English expression at the addressed scope.

Pour forth, we beseech thee, O Lord, thy grace into our hearts; that we, to whom the Incarnation of Christ, thy Son, was made known by the message of an angel, may by his Passion and Cross be brought to the glory of his Resurrection. Through the same Christ, our Lord. Amen.
